why: ownerId is what lets a consumer show the cue to the CONTROLLING player only, which is one of #356's acceptance criteria. The event is emitted for enemy owners too, so a treatment reading a wrong or constant owner would flash on every enemy's blocked shot -- visible only in a multi-tank fixture, never in a one-tank unit test.
killedBy: spawnBullet + ownerShellCount emits fire-blocked for a NON-player owner too, since the cap applies to every owner
spawnBullet + ownerShellCount rejects the player's 6th concurrent shell while 5 are live
what a refused shot says, per refusal path (issue #356) CAPACITY: at the cap, the refusal is announced, with the owner and the reason
